snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer | STAND: Sins of the Immortals
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363460/STAND_Sins_of_the_Immortals/

We’re a tiny team of 5 passionate gamers, and for the past 16 months, we’ve been pouring our hearts into building the indie game we always dreamed of.

STAND: Sins of the Immortals is a dark, fast-paced hack-and-slash made with Unreal Engine 5.
It’s all about intense combat, cursed realms, and that feeling when a game grabs you and doesn’t let go.

We’re so excited to finally share a trailer with you. Let us know what you think in the comments

Subscribe to follow our dev journey from day one.
